function.name: create_payment
function.description: Initiates a new payment transaction. This tool handles the creation of a payment record with essential details such as amount, currency, and recipient.

amount.description: The amount of money to be paid.

recipient_id.description: The unique identifier of the recipient.

payment_method_id.description: The unique identifier for the payment method to be used.

function.name: get_payment_details
function.description: Retrieves the detailed information for a specific payment using its unique ID. This includes status, amount, and transaction history.

payment_id.description: The unique identifier of the payment to retrieve.

function.name: refund_payment
function.description: Processes a refund for a previously made payment. This tool requires the original payment ID and the amount to be refunded.

payment_id.description: The unique identifier of the payment to be refunded.

refund_amount.description: The amount of money to refund. If not specified, the full amount will be refunded.

function.name: list_payments
function.description: Retrieves a list of payments based on various filtering criteria such as status, date range, or recipient. This tool supports pagination.

status.description: Filter payments by their current status (e.g., 'successful', 'failed', 'pending').

start_date.description: Filter payments made after this date (ISO 8601 format).

end_date.description: Filter payments made before this date (ISO 8601 format).

recipient_id.description: Filter payments made to a specific recipient.

limit.description: Maximum number of payments to return (default: 10, max: 100).

offset.description: The number of payments to skip before starting to collect the result set.

function.name: update_payment_status
function.description: Updates the status of an existing payment. This is typically used for administrative purposes or webhook callbacks to reflect changes in payment processing.

payment_id.description: The unique identifier of the payment to update.

new_status.description: The new status for the payment (e.g., 'successful', 'failed', 'cancelled').

reason.description: An optional reason for the status update.

function.name: capture_authorized_payment
function.description: Captures a previously authorized payment, moving it from an authorized state to a captured (completed) state. This tool finalizes the transaction.

authorization_id.description: The unique identifier of the payment authorization to capture.

capture_amount.description: The amount to capture. If not specified, the full authorized amount will be captured.

currency.description: The currency of the capture amount.

function.name: search_products
function.description: Searches for products based on a query, category, and optional filters like price range or brand. This tool helps users find specific items they want to buy.

query.description: The search term for the product (e.g., 'wireless headphones', 'men's running shoes').

category.description: The category to narrow down the search (e.g., 'Electronics', 'Apparel', 'Home Goods').

min_price.description: The minimum price for the product.

max_price.description: The maximum price for the product.

brand.description: The brand of the product to filter by.

page_number.description: The page number for pagination of search results, starting from 1.

function.name: add_to_cart
function.description: Adds a specified quantity of a product to the user's shopping cart. This action is crucial for users to collect items before checkout.

product_id.description: The unique identifier of the product to add to the cart.

quantity.description: The number of units of the product to add.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user performing the action.

color.description: The color variant of the product, if applicable.

size.description: The size variant of the product, if applicable.

function.name: get_cart_contents
function.description: Retrieves the current contents of a user's shopping cart, including product details and quantities. This allows users to review their selections.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user whose cart contents are to be retrieved.

function.name: place_order
function.description: Finalizes the purchase process by creating an order from the current items in the user's cart. This initiates the payment and shipping process.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user placing the order.

shipping_address_id.description: The ID of the selected shipping address.

payment_method_id.description: The ID of the selected payment method.

gift_wrap.description: Boolean indicating if the order should be gift-wrapped.

promo_code.description: An optional promotional code to apply to the order.

function.name: get_order_status
function.description: Checks the current status of a previously placed order using its unique ID. Users can track the progress of their purchases.

order_id.description: The unique identifier of the order to check.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user who placed the order.

function.name: remove_from_cart
function.description: Removes a specific quantity of a product or an entire product line from the user's shopping cart. This allows users to modify their selections before checkout.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user whose cart is being modified.

product_id.description: The unique identifier of the product to remove from the cart.

quantity.description: The number of units of the product to remove. If not provided, all units of the product will be removed.
